# Description
Description of changes

## Type of change
- [ ] `feat`: new feature or enhancement
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix (including crashes and robustness fixes)
- [ ] `perf`: performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: internal restructuring, no behaviour change
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore` / `style`: tooling, formatting (not in the changelog)
- [ ] **Breaking change**: public API or behaviour changes (add `!` to the title, e.g. `feat!:`)


## Checklist
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Do **not** edit `CHANGELOG.md` or create tags; the release workflow does this
